info.name: API Reference Associated Persons Group Policy Intents API

params.name: status
params.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `processing`, `action_required`, `pending_provider_approval`, `policy_created`, `expired`, `provider_rejected`, `manual_renewal_gathering_required`.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of `group_policy_intent`'s. The results are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent appearing first.
Creates a `group_policy_intent` from a `group_quote_intent` that has a quote available. The intent coordinates the policy setup workflow including requirements collection and policy creation.

info.name: List requirements for a group policy intent

params.name: object_type
params.description: Filter by object type (employee or employer)

params.name: object_id
params.description: Filter by object ID (employee ID or employer ID)

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of adaptive requirements for a `group_policy_intent`. Requirements must be fulfilled before policy setup can proceed.
